## Description

Combines ensemble alpha forecasts from multiple machine learning models with split conformal prediction wrappers to construct dynamically sized portfolios bounded by strict error coverage probabilities.

## Where it may fit

High-uncertainty regime transitions, institutional risk-bounded alpha deployment mandates.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Systematic Multi-Strategy Desks.

## Required data

Out-of-sample calibration residuals, multi-model alpha predictions, historical volatility.

## Caveats

Assumes exchangeability between calibration and test sets; requires adaptive conformal extensions for non-stationarity.
